articles.title: Towards an Argumentative Foundation for Evaluative AI
articles.content:
arXiv:2608.07473v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Evaluative AI (EAI) has been recently proposed as a way to support human decision-making, not by producing a single recommendation, but by presenting competing hypotheses together with evidence for and against each. In this position paper, we advocate (computational) argumentation as a particularly suitable paradigm to provide a formal, computable foundation for forms of EAI that are explainable and contestable, setting the ground for a long-term research agenda towards distributed and human-centred EAI systems.

articles.content:
arXiv:2608.07474v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Prior work showed that human-in-the-loop oversight becomes structurally untenable in high-loss domains when AI output velocity V exceeds human cognitive capacity C_max. The operative constraint, however, is not V alone but V x L, where L denotes per-item cognitive load. L consists of triage, judgment, and response, which respond asymmetrically to AI capability improvement. Triage cost does not decline as models become more capable, because semantic indeterminacy is inherent in general-purpose design. Response cost is invariant to accuracy improvements. Only judgment cost faces downward pressure, and this pressure often operates by inducing omission rather than genuine reduction. Capability improvement therefore restructures L rather than reducing it. articles.title: Training Variable Long Sequences with Data-Centric Parallel
articles.content:
arXiv:2608.07524v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Training deep learning models on variable long sequences poses significant computational challenges. Existing methods force a difficult trade-off between efficiency and ease-of-use. Simple approaches use static configurations that cause workload imbalance low efficiency, while complex methods introduces significant complexity and code change for new models. To break this trade-off, we introduce Data-Centric Parallel (DCP). Its core principle is to let the data itself drive the runtime. It achieves this by dynamically adjusting direct runtime settings (e.g., parallel size, gradient accumulation, recomputation) based on each batch's sequence length. articles.content:

Abstract: Linear probes detect corrupted context in language models with near-perfect accuracy, yet this does not translate into reliable failure prediction. Abstract: SHACL is a core technology for validating the conformance of RDF knowledge graphs (KGs). Yet, authoring SHACL shapes requires technical expertise that most domain experts lack. Abstract: Modern agentic AI systems combine multiple large language model agents with heterogeneous skills, yet most architectures either fix communication in advance or allow full broadcast. articles.title: MetaSpace: Metamorphic Testing for Spatial Cognition in Embodied Agents
articles.content:
arXiv:2608.07533v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: An embodied agent is an intelligent entity that interacts with its environment through a physical body. Currently, the evaluation of embodied agents primarily relies on two paradigms: (1) manually annotated Visual Question Answering (VQA) pairs and (2) high-level task completion metrics, such as success in navigation or manipulation. The former is labor-intensive and subject to variability in annotation quality. The latter may obscure critical vulnerabilities, allowing agents to complete tasks through suboptimal means or safety violations, thereby concealing safety risks and inefficiencies. articles.content:
arXiv:2608.07538v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: As LLM agents move from decision support to autonomous procurement, firms need to know whether delegated negotiators create value, divide it predictably, and avoid money-losing contracts. We study this in a canonical supply chain bargaining problem: a buyer with private demand information negotiates a quantity-payment contract with an uninformed seller. articles.content:

Abstract: AI systems increasingly operate between flexible input representations and formal objects used by downstream tools. articles.title: An AI Scientist that Doesn't Drift: Taste, Structure, and Falsifiable Findings in a Quadruped Navigation Research Loop
articles.content:
arXiv:2608.07542v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Autonomous research loops driven by large language models can run machine-learning experiments at scale but tend to drift toward local refinements of whichever metric they optimise rather than testing the hypotheses that motivate the experiments. We address this structurally and present an AI Scientist for studying generalisation in quadruped robot navigation policies in simulation. Building on the autoresearch paradigm of Karpathy, our loop adds three components: an immutable experiment card that pairs each iteration's prediction with its outcome under a fixed schema, so a falsified hypothesis cannot be retconned; specialised subagents restricted to mechanical roles; and kkanbu, a preference oracle that holds the user's research taste as a typed knowledge graph and is the only component permitted to make subjective judgements. To isolate the oracle we run the identical loop twice across eleven research streams, with and without kkanbu.

articles.title: The Field Knows: Cross-Dimensional Geometry from Navigation to Black Holes
articles.content:
arXiv:2608.07566v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: We introduce a continuous metric field framework trained by a single causal contrastive loss. The framework encodes a scene into coefficients of a fixed symmetric matrix basis, assembles them into a Lie algebra element, and exponentiates the result to a Riemannian or Lorentzian metric. Across dimensions, this field discovers the full spectrum of geometric structures: from obstacle-avoiding geodesics in robot navigation across planar and manipulator configuration spaces, to event horizons of black holes in Lorentzian spacetime. Extensive zero-shot generalization studies demonstrate that the field captures transferable geometric structure rather than memorizing specific configurations. articles.title: TeXFix-Bench: An Empirically Grounded Multi-Format Benchmark for LLM-Based Document Source Repair
articles.content:
arXiv:2608.07617v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Scientific and technical writing depends on markup sources that must compile: LaTeX, Typst, and Markdown pipelines fail on missing delimiters, mismatched environments, broken imports, or package conflicts. Existing document-repair evaluations inject faults with ad-hoc edits that lack an empirical fault model. We present TeXFix-Bench, a multi-format benchmark for LLM-based full-source document repair grounded in a mined fault taxonomy. arXiv:2608.07472v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Wildfire prediction models typically discretize study areas into uniform grids, ignoring the heterogeneous spatial distribution of ignitions. We challenge this paradigm by showing that how data is discretized matters more than which model is used. We propose an unsupervised fire-zone segmentation algorithm combining watershed detection with K-means clustering to define prediction units directly from historical fire patterns. Abstract: Dravidian languages, mainly Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam make up only a small part of the data used to train multilingual language models, so it's not clear how much per-language ability these models actually keep. I have trained five GPT-2 architecture models from scratch to compare four monolingual models (one each for Tamil, Telugu, Kannada, and Malayalam, each with its own 32K-vocabulary subword tokenizer) against one multilingual model sharing a 64K-vocabulary subword tokenizer across all four languages. articles.content:
arXiv:2608.07797v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: This paper presents a collaborative UAV-UGV navigation framework for high-altitude, snow-covered terrain, where reduced visibility and unstable ground render conventional methods ineffective. We introduce a custom efficient U-Net architecture that falls under the computational constraints for real-time road segmentation, utilizing a novel synthetic snow data augmentation technique to achieve 96.5% segmentation accuracy. For UAV localization, we implement an Extended Kalman Filter (EKF) fusing onboard GPS and IMU data, achieving a maximum observed positional error of +-0.5 meters. The UGV position is determined via a visual tracking pipeline using YOLOv5 and depth data from the UAV's RGB-D camera. A dynamic path planning algorithm utilizes this segmentation to adjust for snow drifts, enabling successful navigation in obscured test environment with minimal deviation.

articles.title: 消息称 Anthropic 最快今年 9 月上市，向投资者淡化 AI 模型竞争等挑战
articles.content: IT之家 8 月 11 日消息，据华尔街日报报道，Anthropic 正在与潜在投资者展开接触，希望进一步增强市场对公司的信心，为可能成为史上规模最大的 IPO 做准备。公司在与投资者沟通时，重点强调了自身快速增长的势头，以及未来计划采取的一系列策略，并称这些举措有望缓解公众对人工智能日益加剧的反弹情绪。这家估值高达 9,650 亿美元（IT之家注：现汇率约合 6.52 万亿元人民币）的人工智能巨头正面临一系列新的挑战，促使投资者开始更加审慎地审视其业务。其中包括近期中国大受欢迎、价格更低的 AI 系统，Anthropic 与特朗普政府之间的紧张关系，以及美国各地针对数据中心建设日益高涨的反对声音。知情人士透露，过去几周，在 Anthropic 举行的 IPO 前沟通会上，投资者就此类问题向 Anthropic 高管施压，希望了解它们可能对 Anthropic 未来增长产生怎样的影响。这些交流也反映出，目前围绕 AI 竞赛的最终赢家，以及支撑这场 AI 浪潮的相关企业能否保持财务稳定，市场仍存在巨大的不确定性。凭借爆款编程工具 Claude Code 的成功，Anthropic 最近已经在这场 AI 竞赛中脱颖而出。不过，在硅谷内部，针对 Anthropic 的反弹情绪也在升温。越来越多企业 CEO 开始担心，Anthropic 正在 AI 生态系统中拥有越来越大的影响力。Anthropic 最终确定的 IPO 定价，以及上市后的市场表现，将成为投资者评估头部 AI 开发商价值的重要参考。如今，全球投入 AI 领域的资金已经达到数万亿美元，其中大部分用于获取计算资源，而这些巨额投资很大程度上建立在一个核心判断之上：市场对 AI 技术的需求将继续快速增长。知情人士称，Anthropic 高管在与投资者交流时淡化了来自中国 AI 企业的竞争影响。他们表示，Anthropic 目前高度专注于提供最前沿的 AI 模型。Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 以及其他美国顶尖 AI 企业负责人也曾公开表示，大多数用户在任何时候都希望使用智能程度最高的 AI 系统。这意味着，中国 AI 系统目前构成的威胁相对有限，因为它们的整体能力通常仍比顶尖 AI 模型落后至少数个月。知情人士透露，Anthropic 计划在今年 9 月或 10 月初正式上市。其最大竞争对手 OpenAI 预计也将紧随其后启动 IPO，时间最晚可能推迟到明年。参与相关沟通的人士表示，Anthropic 还向部分投资者透露，公司计划进一步拓展 AI 在医疗和生物学领域的应用，并认为这些业务有望帮助缓解部分社会舆论对 AI 的负面情绪。不过，知情人士称，Anthropic 尚未公布具体的 IPO 定价方案和上市时间安排。Anthropic 此次 IPO 恰逢超大型 IPO 交易频频出现的一年。埃隆 · 马斯克旗下 SpaceX 今年早些时候上市后，市值一度突破 2 万亿美元（现汇率约合 13.51 万亿元人民币）。尽管一些乐观的分析师和投资者预计 Anthropic 的市值可能超过这一水平，但 SpaceX 上市初期股价大涨后又出现抛售，也再次提醒投资者，从私人公司走向公开市场的过程可能充满剧烈波动。今年早些时候，Anthropic 凭借 Claude Code 的爆发式增长逐渐领先于其他 AI 公司。Anthropic 今年 5 月曾表示，当月早些时候公司的年化收入已经超过 470 亿美元（现汇率约合 3,175.02 亿元人民币）。过去几周，Anthropic 又与 SpaceX、谷歌等企业达成了一系列新的算力供应协议。使用数据表明，市场对 Claude Code 以及 Anthropic 其他 AI 工具的需求依然强劲。不过，今年以来 Anthropic 的相关服务也曾间歇性出现宕机。

articles.content: IT之家 8 月 11 日消息，科技媒体 The Information 昨日（8 月 10 日）发布博文，报道称美国公众反对建设 AI 数据中心的声浪持续增强，调查称超过 70% 的美国人反对 AI 数据中心。该媒体分析美国各州政府公示的法律文件和地方新闻报道，指出在 2026 年 7 月美国各地禁止新建数据中心的禁令数量激增至 500 多个，而今年 6 月相关禁令数量为 300 多个。报告指出多数美国居民强烈反对在其社区周边建设数据中心，超过 70% 的美国人反对 AI 数据中心，且 2026 年以来，因反对数据中心建设被捕者数量至少超过 37 人。IT之家附上相关截图如下：当地社区居民反对的理由主要聚焦在噪声、水电和环境三个方面，担忧数据中心持续运转产生的噪音，会干扰用户的正常生活，且会推高当地水电价格，并影响当地生态环境。报道指出在 7 月公布的新建数据中心禁令中，接近四分之三位于佐治亚州和佛罗里达州等美国南部。纽约州民主党州长凯西 · 霍楚尔近期签署行政命令，暂停审批耗电量达到或超过 50 兆瓦的数据中心项目。马萨诸塞州和内布拉斯加州停止向开发商提供税收优惠。

articles.content: IT之家 8 月 11 日消息，科技媒体 sammyguru 昨日（8 月 10 日）发布博文，通过挖掘 v1.3.07.3791 版 Nearby Device 应用程序，三星计划在 One UI 9.5 更新中，为应用引入原生深色主题图标。在手机视觉体验上，Galaxy 手机用户遇到的问题之一，就是在深色主屏和壁纸上，应用图标仍保留白色背景，夜间使用时显得突兀。三星原生界面此前不会根据主题设置改变应用图标。泄露内容展示了图库、我的文件、信息和电话拨号器等三星核心应用的深色设计。相关素材表明，三星正为系统级深色图标提供底层支持。Galaxy 用户可以借助第三方启动器或三星 Good Lock 套件方式，调整主屏图标。若系统原生支持深色图标，无需额外安装图标包，应用图标就能自动匹配深色主题和自定义壁纸。图标背景变暗后，主屏上的白色区域也会减少，有望降低夜间使用时的视觉刺激，并让默认 One UI 启动器保持更统一的外观。IT之家援引博文介绍，三星曾经在 One UI 8.5 早期测试版本，短暂测试原生深色图标开关，但最终并未在稳定版中上线。而本次应用代码再次出现相关特性，表明三星有望在 One UI 9.5 更新中部署推送。
